#ifndef ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_
#define ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_

#include <zephyr/ztest.h>
#include <zephyr/sys/iterable_sections.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/**
 * @defgroup ztest_test_deprecated Ztest testing macros (deprecated)
 * @ingroup ztest
 *
 * @brief Ztest testing macros.
 *
 * @deprecated In favor of the new API, see @ref ztest_new_api.
 *
 * @{
 */

/**
 * @brief Define a test case.
 *
 * @param name The test case's name.
 * @param fn The test case's function.
 */
#define ztest_test_case(name, fn) \
	static void fn(void); \
	REGISTER_TEST_CASE(name, fn, 0)

/**
 * @brief Define a user test case.
 *
 * @param name The test case's name.
 * @param fn The test case's function.
 */
#define ztest_user_test_case(name, fn) \
	static void fn(void); \
	REGISTER_TEST_CASE(name, fn, 1)

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite.
 *
 * @param suite The test suite's name.
 * @param ... A list of `ztest_unit_test` to be included in the suite.
 */
#define ztest_test_suite(suite, ...) \
	static struct ztest_unit_test suite[] = { \
		__VA_ARGS__, \
		ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_END \
	}; \
	STRUCT_SECTION_ITERABLE(ztest_suite_node, _ztest_suite_##suite) = { \
		.name = #suite, \
		.unit_tests = suite \
	}

/**
 * @}
 */

/**
 * @defgroup ztest_new_api Ztest new testing API
 * @ingroup ztest
 *
 * @brief Ztest testing macros.
 *
 * This API is a replacement for the now deprecated @ref ztest_test_deprecated.
 *
 * @{
 */

/**
 * @brief Define a test function with setup and teardown.
 *
 * @param fn The test function's name.
 * @param setup The setup function's name.
 * @param teardown The teardown function's name.
 */
#define Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(fn, setup, teardown) \
	{ \
		.name = #fn, \
		.test = fn, \
		.setup = setup, \
		.teardown = teardown, \
	}

/**
 * @brief Define a test function.
 *
 * @param fn The test function's name.
 */
#define ztest_unit_test(fn) \
	Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(fn, NULL, NULL)

/**
 * @brief Define a test function with a setup function.
 *
 * @param fn The test function's name.
 * @param setup The setup function's name.
 */
#define ztest_unit_test_setup(fn, setup) \
	Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(fn, setup, NULL)

/**
 * @brief Define a test function with a teardown function.
 *
 * @param fn The test function's name.
 * @param teardown The teardown function's name.
 */
#define ztest_unit_test_teardown(fn, teardown) \
	Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(fn, NULL, teardown)

/**
 * @brief Define a test function with setup and teardown functions.
 *
 * @param fn The test function's name.
 * @param setup The setup function's name.
 * @param teardown The teardown function's name.
 */
#define ztest_unit_test_setup_teardown(fn, setup, teardown) \
	Z_ZTEST_UNIT_TEST_SETUP_TEARDOWN(fn, setup, teardown)

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with setup and teardown.
 *
 * @internal
 *
 * @param suite The test suite's name.
 * @param setup The setup function's name.
 * @param teardown The teardown function's name.
 * @param ... A list of `ztest_unit_test` to be included in the suite.
 */
#define Z_ZTEST_TEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite, setup, teardown, ...) \
	static struct ztest_unit_test _ztest_unit_test_##suite[] = { \
		__VA_ARGS__ \
	}; \
	STRUCT_SECTION_ITERABLE(ztest_suite_node, _ztest_suite_##suite) = { \
		.name = #suite, \
		.unit_tests = _ztest_unit_test_##suite, \
		.count = ARRAY_SIZE(_ztest_unit_test_##suite), \
		.setup = setup, \
		.teardown = teardown, \
	}

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite.
 *
 * @param suite The test suite's name.
 * @param ... A list of `ztest_unit_test` to be included in the suite.
 */
#define ztest_new_test_suite(suite, ...) \
	Z_ZTEST_TEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite, NULL, NULL, __VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with setup and teardown functions.
 *
 * @param suite The test suite's name.
 * @param setup The setup function's name.
 * @param teardown The teardown function's name.
 * @param ... A list of `ztest_unit_test` to be included in the suite.
 */
#define ztest_test_suite_with_setup_teardown(suite, setup, teardown, ...) \
	Z_ZTEST_TEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite, setup, teardown, __VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Define a simple asynchronous test function.
 *
 * This macro is used to define a simple asynchronous test function that uses a single
 * k_sem to signal completion.
 *
 * @param fn The test function's name.
 */
#define ztest_simple_async_test(fn) \
	static K_SEM_DEFINE(async_sem, 0, 1); \
	static void fn(void *data)

/**
 * @brief End a simple asynchronous test function.
 *
 * This macro is used to end a simple asynchronous test function and wait for the
 * completion signal.
 */
#define ztest_async_test_end() \
	k_sem_take(&async_sem, K_FOREVER)

/**
 * @brief Signal completion of a simple asynchronous test function.
 *
 * This macro is used to signal the completion of a simple asynchronous test function.
 */
#define ztest_async_test_signal() \
	k_sem_give(&async_sem)

/**
 * @}
 */

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_ */
